name: Cortex
tagline: Save and recall full patches. Play your analog oscillators polyphonically — up to 16 voices, allocated live from MIDI.
description:
Modular synths forget. Every patch, every routing, every knob — gone the moment you touch it. Cortex gives your case memory: save and recall full patches, and play your analog oscillators polyphonically with up to 16 voices, allocated live from MIDI.

Your audio stays 100% analog; the brain speaks only CV and gate. Built on open firmware — configure it with the free editor & simulator, or hack it yourself.
